assertions.title: Department scope plus search plus reset returns to overview coherently

steps.action: Open the fixture-backed dashboard in overview state
steps.expected: Overview summary, blocked section, and full table render in place
steps.observed: Dashboard loaded at the same URL with executive summary for all departments, blocked items for Ana Cruz and Mia Park, and 4 total updates across Governance and Operations.

steps.expected: The page scopes to Governance only
steps.observed: The dataset narrowed to 2 Governance updates.

steps.action: Search for 'permit' while Governance scope is active
steps.expected: The results narrow to the Leo Tan row and scoped/search UI is visible
steps.observed: The page showed 1 Governance update for Leo Tan / Permit risk watch, with the clear active scope control visible in the scoped state.

steps.expected: The dashboard returns to the true default overview state
steps.observed: Reset removed the active department scope UI, cleared the search narrowing, restored the executive summary to All Departments with 2 blocked / 4 total updates, brought back the blocked section for Ana Cruz and Mia Park, and restored all 4 table rows.

observed: Scoped/search state showed Governance narrowed to the Leo Tan 'Permit risk watch' row and displayed the clear active scope control.
After Reset, the clear active scope control disappeared.
After Reset, the scoped department indicator/badge was absent.
After Reset, the executive summary returned to ALL DEPARTMENTS with 2 BLOCKED and 4 TOTAL UPDATES.
After Reset, the blocked items section returned with Ana Cruz and Mia Park only.
After Reset, the full table returned with Ana Cruz, Leo Tan, Mia Park, and Zoe Klein rows.
